messages:
marta: Heads-up — spotted a ~40ms p95 jump for /v1/generate (EU) after yesterday's routing tweak. p50 looks unchanged. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
sam: Yep, saw that on the p95 panel. p99 also wiggles but p95 jump is bigger than just the proxy overhead we'd expect (~20ms).
devon: Routing change added a batching/prefetch path for small requests; that can reshape the distribution (more mass at low latencies and a heavier mid tail). We should surface per-endpoint histograms + sample counts. Also, consider tdigest-based percentiles if we're not already using them.
marta: Quick idea — add a "cutpoint" or "trim" mode in the latency UI so you can compare p50/p95/p99 after trimming the top X% (e.g., 0%,1%,5%). Useful to see whether the jump is a small fraction of requests or widespread. Would that be misleading? @lia what's the UX risk here?
lia: UX note: don't enable trimming by default — it can hide real regressions. Expose it as a toggle: "Trim top X% (experimental)" with a short tooltip explaining use-cases. Also add badges for `sample_count` and `sample_origin` (edge/proxy/dedup) next to the percentile so people know data fidelity. :white_check_mark:
sam: Implementation note — we already store t-digests per minute. Computing trimmed quantiles from a tdigest is doable but a bit heavier than a straight quantile query. Suggest precomputing common trims (0,1,5) in the rollup job and surfacing them cheaply in the console. Example query for prototype: 
```
GET /metrics/query?endpoint=/v1/generate&window=5m&metric=latency_p95_trim_1
```
returns JSON with {"value":123, "sample_count": 4200, "percentile_method":"tdigest_trim_1", "sample_origin":"dedup-proxy"}
devon: Also watch out for what we're measuring: client-side total_time vs service_time. Tokenization differences (client batching) can shift percentiles. We should label curves clearly (service_time, ingress_queue, total_time) and tag telemetry with `timing_origin`.
marta: Can we add an optional API flag on /metrics/query to return metadata fields so console can render badges? e.g. `?meta=true` => includes percentile_method and sample_origin.
lia: Yep, expose a small metadata object with keys: ["sample_count","percentile_method","sample_origin"]. Tooltip copy will explain each briefly. Keep prose short.
deploy-bot: deploy: latency-service-4 rolled to prod at 2024-11-02T03:12Z by @devon :rocket:
devon: I'll prototype the API and a tiny backend job that precomputes trims (0/1/5). If we precompute these, console toggles are cheap. Targeting a PR by EOD tomorrow.
sam: I can help with query plan + tdigest ops. Suggest adding an alert rule: "p95 delta > 25% AND sample_count > 1000" to avoid flapping on tiny samples.
marta: Great — action items: Devon+Sam: API/compute plan & PR. Lia: draft tooltip copy + toggle label. We'll sync in dashboard sync next week. Thanks everyone. :v:
